tailoring.headline: Senior Product Analyst / E-Commerce Developer | Java, Spring, SQL & Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend and techno-functional developer with 5+ years of experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms, optimizing databases, and executing data pipelines and API integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Proven expertise in requirements analysis, process mapping, and collaborating with international stakeholders across agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Product Analyst - Quick Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am eager to join Delivery Hero to support Local Shops vendor onboarding and integration in Quick Commerce, bringing over 5 years of robust backend and techno-functional experience from my work at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My background bridging technical implementations with business requirements makes me an ideal fit for analyzing operational data and scaling non-food offerings.

bullets.label: Data Pipelines & Integration Analysis
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation, I designed and optimized complex data pipelines and investigated integration bottlenecks between ERP, MDM, and e-commerce systems, ensuring high data accuracy and smooth vendor catalog synchronization.

bullets.label: Business & Requirements Analysis
bullets.text: Operating in a techno-functional role, I have extensive experience gathering business requirements, analyzing operational data, writing user stories and functional specifications, and collaborating with cross-functional international stakeholders.

bullets.label: SQL & Query Performance Tuning
bullets.text: At Shell, I led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, demonstrating deep expertise in data analysis, SQL performance tuning, and system optimization.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: I routinely partner with product owners, business teams, and technical engineers in agile environments to map processes, align on success criteria, and support user acceptance testing.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026 (earliest start 16.12.2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my analytical and integration expertise supports Delivery Hero's goals.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at Delivery Hero because of its pioneering role in Quick Commerce and the vibrant, high-performance culture in Berlin. Scaling non-food offerings and optimizing vendor integration within billions of daily transactions presents an exciting analytical challenge that aligns perfectly with my background in data integration and techno-functional problem-solving.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise platform experience, deep SQL and data analysis skills, and a strong techno-functional background to support vendor onboarding and integration at Delivery Hero.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise platform and integration experience, strong SQL skills, and a techno-functional background bridging business and IT, I have applied for the Senior Product Analyst role at Delivery Hero. I would love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Product Analyst - Quick Commerce - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Senior Product Analyst - Quick Commerce position at Delivery Hero.

With over 5 years of experience in enterprise platforms, data pipelines, SQL optimization, and techno-functional stakeholder management, I am confident in my ability to drive valuable insights and support vendor onboarding in your Local Shops team.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
